title: ParagraphMap — mechanical instruction enumeration, one human column (M11, Phase C4)
description: Run-local companion to the WorkSpec unit map: the frozen instruction enumerated paragraph by paragraph (derived by rsclib paragraph_skeleton — index, 1-based inclusive lines, SHA-256 over each block's lines joined with "\n" and UTF-8 encoded — line endings normalized, no trailing newline) with exactly one human-filled column, classification. Makes the p3-corr omission class mechanical: a paragraph can be misclassified but never silently absent, and the run-v2 authoring gate cross-checks map ⟷ instruction bytes ⟷ instruction units before START. Authored run-locally, zero signed bytes; joined the pack 2026-07-31, and is part of the E2-frozen surface as of the 2026-08-03 re-baseline.

schema_version.description: The instance names its own schema from birth (the wave-1 authoring principle applied forward).

instruction_ref.description: The exact frozen instruction this map enumerates — must equal the WorkSpec's instruction_ref; the authoring gate enforces the equality.

paragraphs.description: One entry per derived paragraph, in skeleton order. The classification result lives on each enumerated entry — a parallel result array is unrepresentable here (the ⑤ alignment-tax lesson).

classification.description: The single human-filled column. Absence is refused, never defaulted (defect M8's lesson): a freshly generated skeleton is schema-invalid until a human answers every entry.

paragraphEntry.description: One derived paragraph: machine columns from paragraph_skeleton plus the human classification.
